title: Toronto/GTA emergency plumbers and electricians: open data (Hailtrades)
description: Open dataset of 7,011 residential emergency plumbers and electricians in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area: hours, 24/7 and emergency availability, licence numbers, free-quote flags and published call-out/hourly fees. Published by Hailtrades (https://hailtrades.com). Live data: https://hailtrades.com/data. Public MCP server: https://hailtrades.com/mcp.
